fieldData.full-article-text:
For the Olympia mainnet, the Radix protocol automatically chooses the top 100 nodes that have the most stake (the sum of self-stake and delegated stake) as those that participate as validators. The top 100 validators are updated by the protocol at the start of every epoch. 

Please visit the Radix Overview for more information on how validators are selected.

fieldData.name: How are validators selected for the Olympia Mainnet?
